response.sql:
WITH timing_averages AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS avg_of_group_averages
  FROM timing_averages
)
SELECT AVG(t.avg_instownpct) AS mean_above_baseline_group_average,
       AVG(t.avg_instownpct - b.avg_of_group_averages) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM timing_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE t.avg_instownpct > b.avg_of_group_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Timing groups with no non-missing instownpct values have a NULL average and are excluded from the baseline and above-baseline calculations, as SQLite AVG ignores NULL values.
